mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for AI-optimizing a website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an AI-driven audit of your existing website for technical SEO, content gaps, and user experience. Next, AI tools assist in comprehensive keyword and intent research to identify opportunities. This is followed by AI-assisted content creation and optimization, including structured data implementation. Finally, continuous monitoring and iterative adjustments are made using AI analytics to ensure ongoing performance and adaptation to algorithm changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an AI audit, AI-assisted keyword research, content optimization, structured data implementation, and continuous monitoring with AI analytics.
